about: Eval set for the voice fast lane's answerer (docs/native/PLAN.md 8.4.1-8.4.2): what it says once the router lets it answer. Every name and title is a placeholder. Each case builds its snapshot with the real formatSnapshot from `now` (local time) and `meetings` (minutes from midnight of `now`'s day: 600 = 10:00 today, 1440 + 600 = 10:00 tomorrow). Checks: `times` must all be spoken (any of `anyTimes`), `notToday` times may only be spoken with the word tomorrow (or the weekday), `empty` = it must say nothing is left, `noTimes` = no clock time at all, and no title may be turned into who the meeting is with.

cases.note: the reviewer's case: Sunday 14:53, nothing left today, four meetings on Monday

cases.text: Anything left on my calendar today?
